p<0.01)."}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among ART-naive clients, initiation rates were lower among those aged <15 years than among those aged ≥15 years"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "These TPT completions meaningfully contributed to the 2018 UNHLM target for TPT among persons with HIV"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The TPT initiation rate peaked in FY19 Q4 (11%)"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Mann-Whitney-U tests (α = 0.05) were used to assess stratum-specific differences in TPT initiation and completion rates."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "TPT completion rates were calculated as the number of TPT completions in a 6-month period"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Analysis of TPT initiation rates among ART-naive clients included only those initiating TPT within 6 months of ART initiation."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "TPT initiation and completion rates were aggregated across all PEPFAR-supported programs."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types", "analytic_depth"]}
